summary: The ChangeReminder functionality revolves around managing and verifying password reminder questions. It includes a UI for users to change their forgotten password question, ensuring the input meets specific validation criteria.
purpose: To facilitate the process of changing a forgotten password question through a user interface, ensuring valid and secure input.

fields.name: txtCurrentPassword
fields.description: Field for entering the current password.

fields.name: txtReminderQuestion
fields.description: Field for entering a custom reminder question.

fields.name: ddReminderQuestion
fields.description: Dropdown to select a predefined reminder question.

fields.name: txtAnswer
fields.description: Field for entering the answer to the reminder question.

workflows.name: Change Forgotten Password Question
steps: User navigates to the Change Reminder page.
User selects a reminder question from the dropdown or opts to enter a custom reminder question.
User provides an answer to the reminder question.
On success, the system updates the reminder question.
On failure, error or warning messages are displayed.

business_rules: Reminder question should be at least 10 characters long if entered manually.
Answer must be at least 4 characters long.
validations: Validation on the reminder question to ensure it's either selected from the dropdown or the custom input has at least 10 characters.
Validation to ensure the answer is at least 4 characters long.
Validation to ensure the current password field is filled.
conditions: If a custom reminder question is entered, it must be visible and not empty.
If using dropdown, ensure a valid selection is made.
system_behavior: Upon successful validation, redirect the user to a confirmation or main tools page.
Display error messages if validation fails.
exceptions: Invalid reminder question or answer according to the business rules.
